highlights.title: Long permission requests can be allowed
highlights.line: When a Claude agent asks permission for a long command, the board now shows the whole request with Allow, not only a way to refuse it.

highlights.title: A waiting agent says why
highlights.line: Point at a waiting agent's status and it now says why in plain words, such as a question to answer or a permission to give.

highlights.title: Built but waiting
highlights.line: On Projects, an active project with nothing running and work built and waiting now says Built but waiting instead of looking idle.
